about: The belt merge-delay table factory-sim ships (fsim/data/belt-delay.*), measured by tools/probe_logistics4.py --family delaymap; docs/sim-logistics.md, 'Fourth probe'. The table itself (264,256 values, 323 KiB xz) lives in factory-sim; this records where it came from and how it was checked.
method: each tile measured twice, facing north and facing east: a belt at the tile, its downstream neighbour destroyed and rebuilt every tick, the first on_tick t (from the build command) at which their lines are equal; where the two differ, the one reading 1 had a neighbour whose own d is 1 and the other stands
runs: each rectangle and facing: six worlds in parallel on the desktop, 2.5 min for 256 x 256 tiles

resample.what: 600 random tiles of the first two rectangles (seed 20260925) re-measured in fresh worlds: facing north twice (f0r0, f0r1), east, south, west once each; logistics4-delaycheck.json.xz

checks.overlap: the 32 x 32 tiles [96,128)^2 measured in two rectangles agree, both facings

hash: not identified: uniform on 1..600, lanes and neighbouring tiles uncorrelated (|r| < 0.005); FNV-1a, splitmix64, MurmurHash3/lowbias32/Wang/PCG finalisers, LCGs, minstd, taus88 and mt19937 seeded from tile or 1/256 coordinates and the lane (many encodings, mod 599/600/601 and multiply-shift) match at chance level (best 17 of 3,000)
